alternative_explanations: True small training effect masked by power.
bottlenecks.argument_against: Matched C0/D1 still share residual LoRA/vLLM path differences.
bottlenecks.argument_for: Original +8.8pp used mismatched HF vs vLLM backends; matched contrast is smaller.

c0_hf_vs_c0_vllm_if_present.note: C0-HF must not be mixed into the main training-effect contrast.

bottlenecks.next_step: Keep matched vLLM eval as the only training-effect contrast; freeze eval script hash.

bottlenecks.argument_against: Even a balanced 300 may still yield small transfer.
bottlenecks.argument_for: D1 train_subset_300 is not identical to the local train_grpo_pilot3 prefix/freeze; selection provenance is broken or the export was regenerated.
bottlenecks.next_step: Freeze SHA256 of exact D1 subset; nested stratified subset by cell×call_bucket×motif×track; never silent file-prefix slices.

bottlenecks.argument_against: Factory intentionally uses synthetic surfaces; some transfer still observed.
bottlenecks.argument_for: Diagnostic gold tools largely outside factory exact namespace; transfer relies on schema/lexical proxies.
bottlenecks.next_step: Paired A-native/G-general renderers; NESTFUL-like output keys; harder schema-compatible distractors.

bottlenecks.argument_against: Without per-rollout groups cannot separate all-success vs all-fail cells.
bottlenecks.argument_for: Aggregate dead_group_rate=0.51 and low unique rewards imply many non-informative GRPO groups.
bottlenecks.next_step: Add difficulty-targeted cells + persist per-rollout rewards; balance effective-group rate.

bottlenecks.argument_against: Cannot quantify from stored trajectories alone.
bottlenecks.argument_for: D1 uses adapter; C0 is base. Path differences can shift decoding even at T=0.
bottlenecks.next_step: Future A/B: base+null-LoRA vs D1 under identical vLLM loader.

bottlenecks.argument_against: Topology coverage may not associate with gained/lost if surface mismatch dominates.
bottlenecks.argument_for: High top-1 topology share and/or high diagnostic unseen-topology rate indicate shape mismatch risk.
bottlenecks.next_step: Cap top-1 topology family share; raise unique topology quota; joint topology×call_count matching.

bottlenecks.argument_against: Registry size alone does not explain gap; exact IBM clone is not required.
bottlenecks.argument_for: Unmapped diagnostic gold tools on critical path associate with persistent failures (proxy).
bottlenecks.next_step: Expand abstract operation families with high eval frequency + low coverage + low D1 gain.

bottlenecks.argument_against: Nearest-neighbor OOD may not predict flips at n=27/16.
bottlenecks.argument_for: Margin match can hide unseen joint cells (topology×calls×answer×track).
bottlenecks.next_step: Selection objective: joint deficit matching + rare-cell floors.

bottlenecks.argument_for: If train distractors are lexically far / type-impossible, model learns weak discrimination.
bottlenecks.next_step: Minimum distractor hardness gate; schema-compatible near-miss distractors.

bottlenecks.argument_against: More easy data can worsen dead groups.
bottlenecks.argument_for: n=300 with 51% dead groups yields few effective updates; underpowered for +2pp.
bottlenecks.next_step: Scale only after effective-group and joint-coverage constraints.

alternative_explanations: Argument value errors mislabeled as reference.
bottlenecks.argument_against: Parser accepts multiple formats; may not drive official_win.
bottlenecks.argument_for: Train and diagnostic may differ in $var vs $var_ and output key conventions.

examples.unparsed_dollar_string: The cost of the item is $12.50 and the tax is $2.50

bottlenecks.next_step: Validation gate on reference syntax + output-key distribution vs TargetProfile.

alternative_explanations: Genuine skill learning on narrow family.
bottlenecks.argument_against: Shortcuts may be limited after paraphrase.
bottlenecks.argument_for: Template concentration / shortcut cues can inflate train reward without transfer.

metrics.note: Lexical/template proxies only; not proof of reward hacking.

bottlenecks.next_step: Template-skeleton concentration gate; anti-leak checks in V7+.

bottlenecks.argument_for: Single seed run; flips could be seed noise.
bottlenecks.next_step: Multi-seed train only after data composition fix.

generation_cell_recommendations.distractor_requirement: schema-compatible near-miss; mean hardness proxy increase 1.5–2×
evidence: diagnostic unseen topology rate vs train300=0.240
generation_cell_recommendations.expected_mechanism: Reduce shape collapse and force surface-invariant dependency skill.
generation_cell_recommendations.recommended_relative_quota: increase unique topologies ≥2×; cap top-1 topology share ≤10%
generation_cell_recommendations.risk: Over-diversifying topologies without reward signal wastes capacity.
generation_cell_recommendations.surface_requirement: A-native and G-general paired renders of same program
generation_cell_recommendations.topology_requirement: increase unique topology hashes; cap top-1 family share below 10%

evidence: linear chains dominate many factory curricula historically
generation_cell_recommendations.expected_mechanism: Teach non-linear dependency / fan-in that diagnostic programs use.
generation_cell_recommendations.recommended_relative_quota: increase fan-in/reuse cells 1.5–2× vs current linear share
generation_cell_recommendations.reference_requirement: multi-parent refs with distinct output keys
generation_cell_recommendations.risk: Harder graphs may raise all-fail dead groups if too hard.

evidence: mean_unique_rewards low in train log aggregates
generation_cell_recommendations.expected_mechanism: Increase fraction of mixed-reward groups so GRPO updates are informative.
